messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — planning a thermal hotspot rotation window for us-east1 tonight 02:00–04:00 UTC. Goal: rotate tasks off a handful of GPU nodes that are showing sustained 85%+ package temp and contention in the nvlink lanes. Will do staggered reboots with backfill to avoid capacity cliffs.

Jon: +1. Which pools are in-scope?

Maria: Targeting pool-gamma (inference-heavy) and a small cohort in pool-saturn (batch). Approx 40 GPUs total across 5 racks. Not touching dedicated customer pools unless we see immediate regressions.

Sasha: Can we run a preflight heatmap and prefix-cache seed before rotation? Last time cold KV cache caused latency spikes.

Maria: Yep — plan is: 1) pre-seed KV caches on canaries 2) cordon node 3) migrate active sessions off (graceful drain 60s) 4) reboot with BMC thermal cool-down script 5) uncordon and validate. Pre-seed command: `reefctl exec --pool pool-gamma --script preseed-kv.sh --concurrency 6`

infra-bot: Scheduled window created: maintenance/7192468000. Auto-notify to affected tenant owners at 01:30 UTC.

Kevin: Cost note — backfill will hit burst capacity for ~20m in each rack. Expect ~0.4% additional GPU-hour for the window. Ops budget is fine but flagging to finance.

Priya: Can we reduce burst by rebalancing small jobs to apac-region temporarily? Network egress for those jobs will spike. Suggest marking low-priority tenants for optional spill.

Jon: For rollback: if canaries show >5% p99 latency regression after uncordon, we should stop and roll nodes back to pre-rotation image. Is that in the runbook?

Maria: Yes — runbook excerpt: ```
- If canary p99 increases >5% for 10m -> abort further reboots
- Revert recent kernel/driver patch via `reefctl rollback --image v2026-03-hotfix`
- Notify @ops-oncall immediately and mark window as extended
```

Sasha: Also add a check for nvlink error counters: `nvlinkctl show --threshold 50` — if errors > threshold, escalate to hw-team.

ops-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. Will stream logs to #eng-oncall and have a terminal open for fast rollback. Please ping me before the first cordon.

Maria: Thanks — timeline: preflight 01:15 UTC, tenant notices 01:30, start canaries 02:00, full staggered rotation 02:20–03:50, final validation 03:50–04:00. Will post short status updates every 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya: Noted — I'll trigger temporary spill rules for low-priority batch jobs at 01:50.

Kevin: Finance acked the small burst cost.

Jon: Sounds good. Ping when you start canaries.

Maria: Will do. If anything unexpected, we'll pause and triage. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
